turns.text: We think ants are industrious, or hard-working.
turns.zh: 我们总觉得蚂蚁很勤劳，或者说很卖力。

turns.text: Groups of ants, called colonies, seem tiny, perfect societies where everyone works hard for the good of the group.
turns.zh: 一群群的蚂蚁，也就是蚁群，看起来像微型的完美社会，每个成员都在为集体的利益努力工作。

turns.text: Then why are so many of them inactive?
turns.zh: 那为什么它们中有那么多都不干活呢？

turns.text: One possible answer is that they’re reserve ants, ready to step in if disease or disaster strike.
turns.zh: 一个可能的答案是，它们是储备蚁，随时准备在疾病或灾难来袭时顶上。

turns.text: But could it simply be that they don’t work because they don’t need to.
turns.zh: 但会不会只是它们不工作是因为不需要呢？

turns.text: Would you get out of bed on Monday morning if you didn’t have to?
turns.zh: 如果周一早上你不用非得起床，你还会起来吗？

turns.text: Maybe the ants can teach us a thing or two about relaxing.
turns.zh: 也许蚂蚁能教我们一两招关于放松的事。

turns.text: But wouldn't it get boring just sitting around all day?
turns.zh: 但整天坐着无所事事，难道不会无聊吗？
